steps.name: Step 1 — Navigate to a pipeline with a runnable LLM node in Flow view
Step 2 — Send a message in the embedded chat and wait for the run to complete
Step 3 — Click the run's label to open the Run Details panel
Step 4 — Verify the panel header reads "Run N details"
Step 5 — Verify a "Completed" green status badge appears next to the header
Step 6 — Verify a trash (delete) icon button is present in the panel header
Step 7 — Verify the header's second icon button (Close) is present (case's 'expand/fullscreen' wording is stale — see docstring CLARIFICATION)
Step 8 — Verify the panel contains a TIMELINE STEP section and a STATES section
